title: Order fulfilment
idea: Order fulfilment: Paid ready and dispatched orders expose fulfilment blockers
audience: People who need to fulfil within a dashboard surface.
worksWellWhen: Physical orders move through verified stages
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic transaction layout through its fulfil priority and explicit commitment contract: Fulfilment is idempotent and never granted by redirect alone
navigation: Order fulfilment keeps the current fulfil context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Paid ready and dispatched orders expose fulfilment blockers
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to fulfil; physical orders move through verified stages
composition.priority: Fulfilment is idempotent and never granted by redirect alone

imagery.role: Support the actual fulfil context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep purchase and shipment states separately labeled
Keep units, filters and selection understandable at narrow widths; expose a focused item view.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the order fulfilment structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no fulfil content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Fulfilment is idempotent and never granted by redirect alone
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized fulfil content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Fulfilment is idempotent and never granted by redirect alone
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active fulfil context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure bounded queries and large-data interaction; virtualize only with accessible alternatives.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
